title: Global combat constants
description: Tunables of the damage-mitigation formulas themselves (not of any one entity), plus the elite-monster modifier block (G7, docs/0020) applied uniformly to whichever monster a spawn's elite roll picks. Loaded identically by the Godot client and the Go server, so it is the single source of truth for these numbers. See docs/0005-data-driven-balance.md.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this file's shape.

armor_constant.description: The K in the armour formula `armor / (armor + K * hit)`. Higher K makes armour weaker.

max_physical_reduction.description: Hard cap on physical damage reduction, as a fraction.

max_resistance.description: Hard cap on elemental resistance, as a fraction.

spawn_chance.description: Probability MonsterSpawnPicker.roll_is_elite gives each spawn of becoming an elite variant.

visual_scale.description: Uniform scale factor applied to an elite's built visual (Monster._build_visual's output) and its floating health bar's height.

move_speed_multiplier.description: Applied to move_speed for an elite; < 1 makes elites slower despite their bulk.

max_health_multiplier.description: Applied to max_health for an elite.

xp_multiplier.description: Applied to xp_reward for an elite kill.
